title: kan-extension
description: The universal extension of a functor F : C → D along a functor K : C → E. The left Kan extension Lan_K(F) : E → D is the best approximation of F factoring through K, characterized by a universal natural transformation. Limits, colimits, adjunctions, and sheafification are all Kan extensions. Itself a functor, refined by the universal property.

along.description: the functor K : C → E the extension is taken along

extends.description: the functor F : C → D being extended

universal.description: universal natural transformation η : F ⇒ Lan_K(F) ∘ K (left), dually ε for the right Kan extension
